authority: p2.7a approval; finding F-P27-DEADLINE; Root adjudication
required_behavior_root_adjudication: No elapsed-time termination of an experiment (BRIEF '실험 실행 시간 상한 없음', C-AC-07 '경과 시간만으로 실험을 종료하지 않는다', OPERATING-CONTRACT §3): after EXPERIMENT_START the supervisor waits for the main program without any deadline, and after MAIN_RETURN it keeps tracking live managed descendants without a deadline (report MAIN_RETURN; lifecycle stays 'descendants alive' / not complete, per C-AC-08 example '주 프로그램은 끝났지만 후손이 생존'); ending an experiment happens only via explicit stop/force paths already governed by CW-13/CW-15 policy.

Bounded deadlines remain only for startup/handshake steps whose failure means the run never started correctly (e.g. exec-transition acknowledgement, RUN framing, release handshakes); they must not kill a running experiment. Rename/split the parameter so the startup handshake timeout cannot be confused with experiment runtime; PersistentShell.submit and TaskWorkflow.start must not impose a runtime limit (remove the 300 s cap for runtime).

Audit the whole automated-run path (supervisor, lifecycle probe _drain, PersistentShell, workflow/run.py, observation/worker review) for any other elapsed-time rule that terminates or marks unknown a healthy running experiment or its descendants; fix those in allowed paths and report any outside.

If the rejected wb-handoff arrives outside the control loop (HANDOFF -> HOOK_REJECTED with no WAIT), treat HOOK_REJECTED itself as the authenticated return-to-prompt event for manual input (READY may never come when the user removed hooks); automation stays held.
dash: do not leave ENV pointing at the Workbench shell-init in the user/experiment environment after init (C-AC-32 separation), if feasible without breaking dash init; otherwise report why.
Keep all input-boundary behavior of attempts 01/02, automation holds, no replay, exact identity.
acceptance_tests: add red/green tests: default submit experiment running > 60 s survives and completes normally; main returns while a descendant lives > 10 s -> not complete, then completes when descendant exits, never killed by elapsed time

all suites of the input unit: tests/terminal, tests/gates/g2_shell (PYTHONPATH=src:.), canonical matrix, tests/backend, tests/contracts, tests/lifecycle, tests/gates/g4_lifetime (PYTHONPATH=src:.), plus tests/workflow and tests/observation non-live suites
stop_conditions: an existing test asserts experiment kill by elapsed time: list it with the contradicted clause; do not silently delete
fix requires changing CW-13/CW-15 stop/force policy or contracts
